title: SelfHostedWorkHeartbeatResponse

last_heartbeat.title: Last Heartbeat
last_heartbeat.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent heartbeat recorded for this work item, or an empty string if none has been recorded

lease_extended.title: Lease Extended
lease_extended.description: Whether the heartbeat succeeded in extending the lease

state.title: State
state.description: Current state of the work item (active/stopping/stopped)

ttl_seconds.title: Ttl Seconds
ttl_seconds.description: Effective TTL applied to the lease

description: Response after recording a heartbeat for a work item.
